name: Cannalope Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Cannalope is a tropical twist that lives up to its name. This indica brings a juicy burst of melon on the inhale, rounded out by sweet tropical fruit notes. The exhale adds depth with pine and spice from its kush lineage, giving this fruity favorite a bold edge. Bright, flavorful, and full of character, Cannalope tastes like vacation in every puff.
